plate.desc: a calm paper-cut coastline at dawn: a pale teal sea, a sliver of off-white beach, a few stylized paper palm fronds, mustard-yellow sun just above the horizon, a large empty area in the upper half

transitions.motion: The paper horizon folds forward like a card and thirty paper tiles unfold out of it into a neat grid; locked-off camera, slow, smooth.
transitions.fallback: tiles scale in from the center with a 60 ms stagger

transitions.motion: The thirty tiles slide together and merge into one pale-teal paper peninsula; locked-off camera.
transitions.fallback: tiles morph (mask) into the map outline

transitions.motion: Camera pushes in slowly on the paper peninsula as its inner layers shift and a blade re-cuts one edge; thin paper strips curl away.
transitions.fallback: map scale-up 140% with the two districts highlighting

transitions.motion: The cut paper layers settle; three mustard-yellow paper discs drop in one after another and bounce once.
transitions.fallback: three pins drop with a 3-frame bounce

transitions.motion: The three discs slide apart and each splits into two, becoming a row of six small paper windows.
transitions.fallback: pins become six slots by mask

transitions.motion: The six windows slide to the edges and the frame splits into an ink half and a teal half with a torn seam.
transitions.fallback: vertical wipe with a torn-edge matte

transitions.motion: The seam holds while two horizontal paper strips slide in from the left and stop at nearly equal lengths.
transitions.fallback: bars grow from zero over 0.6 s

transitions.motion: The strips fold away and a paper price tag drops on its string and swings once.
transitions.fallback: cross-dissolve with the tag easing in

transitions.motion: The tag swings out of frame and two stacks of paper slips of different heights rise from the bottom edge.
transitions.fallback: two bars rise from the baseline

transitions.motion: Both stacks slide into a row and three round paper stamps press down in turn, each leaving a faint blank imprint.
transitions.fallback: three chips stamp in at 10-frame intervals

transitions.motion: A hard cut: a single flash of brass-colored paper sweeps across the frame left to right on the beat, revealing a tall teal paper arch.
transitions.fallback: hard cut on the beat with a 4-frame yellow flash

transitions.motion: The arch's inner space darkens slightly and a cone of pale yellow paper light falls onto an empty stage between teal curtains.
The stage light lowers and two horizontal paper strips slide up into place, ink slightly longer than teal.
transitions.fallback: bars grow, portraits scale to equal size

transitions.motion: The strips fall away and a paper slider track appears; its yellow marker begins to slide.
transitions.fallback: marker animates from 8 to 4 over 1 s

transitions.motion: The slider track folds in half and becomes two identical blank paper cards side by side.
transitions.fallback: two cards slide in from opposite sides at the same speed

transitions.motion: A broad sweep of paper strips clears everything to an empty off-white field in one smooth motion.
transitions.fallback: wipe to off-white, then hold 6 frames

transitions.motion: Concentric yellow and teal paper semicircles rise on the horizon like a sunrise and settle; a pale sea and a sliver of beach slide in beneath.
transitions.fallback: sunrise shapes rise over 1 s, end card fades in
